PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/search/?q=defibrillator" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "guides: $\($j.guides.Count\)  devices: $\($j.devices.Count\)  classification: $\($j.classification.Count\)  recalls: $\($j.recalls.Count\)"; if \($j.guides.Count -gt 0\) { $j.guides[0].title }; if \($j.classification.Count -gt 0\) { $j.classification[0].device_name + " \(Class " + $j.classification[0].device_class + "\)" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.ifixit.com/api/2.0/search/iphone%20battery?filter=guide&limit=3" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "guide filter total: $\($j.totalResults\)"; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.ifixit.com/api/2.0/wikis/CATEGORY/Baxter%20Infusion%20Pump" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; $j2 = $r2.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "category guides: $\($j2.guides.Count\)")

PowerShell(Copy-Item .env.example .env; "copied"; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/analyze/" -Method POST -Body @{question="test"; mode="identify"} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60 } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\); "status: $\([int]$resp.StatusCode\) body: $\($sr.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" })

PowerShell($c = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/" -UseBasicParsing -SessionVariable sess; $token = \($sess.Cookies.GetCookies\("http://127.0.0.1:8000/"\) | Where-Object Name -eq "csrftoken"\).Value; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/analyze/" -Method POST -WebSession $sess -Headers @{"X-CSRFToken"=$token} -Body @{question="test"; mode="identify"} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; $r.Content } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\); "status: $\([int]$resp.StatusCode\) body: $\($sr.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; $c = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/" -UseBasicParsing -SessionVariable sess; $token = \($sess.Cookies.GetCookies\("http://127.0.0.1:8000/"\) | Where-Object Name -eq "csrftoken"\).Value; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/analyze/" -Method POST -WebSession $sess -Headers @{"X-CSRFToken"=$token} -Body @{question="quick ping"; mode="identify"} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120; "status 200: $\($r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(200, $r.Content.Length\)\)\)" } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\); "status: $\([int]$resp.StatusCode\) body: $\($sr.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" })

PowerShell($c = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/" -UseBasicParsing -SessionVariable sess -TimeoutSec 15; $token = \($sess.Cookies.GetCookies\("http://127.0.0.1:8000/"\) | Where-Object Name -eq "csrftoken"\).Value; "token: $\($token.Substring\(0,8\)\)..."; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/analyze/" -Method POST -WebSession $sess -Headers @{"X-CSRFToken"=$token} -Body @{question="quick ping"; mode="identify"} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; "status 200" } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if \($resp\) { $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\); "status: $\([int]$resp.StatusCode\) body: $\($sr.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" } else { "no response: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
